[[File:Champions_and_Mandalore.png|thumb|right|200px|Mandalore the Vindicated and his fellow Grand Champions]]
The '''Grand Champion of the Great Hunt''' was an honored position taken by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] which was made by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. It signified elite warriors that had successfully completed the trials of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. Those inducted into their ranks were provided exclusive access to the [[Blacklist]] and typically always included a member of the Mandalorians. In the Cold War, [[Mandalore the Vindicated]] sat amongst the Grand Champions but passed his post to an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] that had completed the trials of the Great Hunt.
